name: Case Converter
summary: Convert text between upper, lower, title, camel, snake, kebab, and more — instantly in your browser.
description: Flip casing for prose or identifiers. Supports UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and CONSTANT_CASE. All conversion runs locally.

faqs.question: Does it upload my text?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: How does camelCase handle existing identifiers?
faqs.answer: It splits on spaces, underscores, hyphens, and camelCase boundaries first, then rebuilds the target style.

faqs.question: Is Title Case perfect for every language?
faqs.answer: It capitalizes letters after word boundaries using Unicode-aware rules. Specialized style guides may still differ.
